documents.text: ##### .getDecorator(name) Returns the value of a request decorator declared with [`decorateRequest`](./Decorators.md#decoraterequestname-value-dependencies). If the decorator is a function, it is returned bound to the request. It throws an `FST_ERR_DEC_UNDECLARED` error if the decorator has not been declared. See [`getDecorator`](./Decorators.md#getdecoratorname) for more details. ```js fastify.decorateRequest('user', null) fastify.get('/', function (request, reply) { const user = request.getDecorator('user') reply.send({ user }) }) ```
